sources.source_name: ADR Part 3: Donor-wise Electoral Bonds details (corporate & individual donors, 12 Apr 2019 - 15 Feb 2024)
notes: Donor names kept verbatim as printed, including the source's own typesetting breaks ('LI MITED', 'PVT L TD', 'LTDPROPRIET').
Row 8 spans two printed lines; joined with a single space; trailing '*' kept as printed (source footnote: combined entries).

This source aggregates each donor's total over 12 Apr 2019 - 15 Feb 2024; no per-bond dates and no donor-to-party linkage are printed, so party_name and bond_date are NULL (displayed as NOT AVAILABLE IN SOURCE DATA).
Source's own inside-PDF citation: 'Election Commission of India as on 14th March 2024. Data Compiled and Analysed by ADR.'

mirror_hunt_notes: Hunt completed 2026-09-23 after eci.gov.in proved unreachable (HTTP 406 bot wall on all project network routes, incl. live browser).
No downloadable bond-level dataset found from Alt News, NewsLaundry, Reporters' Collective, The Hindu/Data, Scroll.in, or The Quint (searches returned analysis articles only, no data files).
Dataful (dataful.in/datasets/19700) hosts a matched dataset but its page is JS-gated and downloads were not retrievable from here; not obtained.
Wayback Machine: all archived captures of eci.gov.in/disclosure-of-electoral-bonds return 403; no archived ECI bond PDFs located via CDX.
Nothing in this section has been ingested into Neon. Ingestion requires a separate verified pass.
